setup: The derivative of a sum is the sum of the derivatives, so differentiate \([[a]]x^{[[n]]}\) and \([[b]]x^{[[m]]}\) separately.

steps.say: Power rule on the first term: \(\frac{d}{dx}[[a]]x^{[[n]]} = [[a]] \cdot [[n]] x^{[[exp1]]} = [[d1]]\).
Power rule on the second: \(\frac{d}{dx}[[b]]x^{[[m]]} = [[b]] \cdot [[m]] x^{[[exp2]]} = [[d2]]\).
